abstract.t: This document defines an experimental Conversation-ID email header field. Participating originators can use it to associate messages with a conversation, alongside Message-ID, In-Reply-To, and References. The identifier is independent of any one message's Message-ID. Its usefulness depends on originators copying it into new messages and intermediaries preserving it during transport. The field is an untrusted grouping hint and provides no authentication or authorization. This document specifies its syntax and processing rules and describes an experiment to compare it with existing correlation methods.
